FIFO (First-In First-Out) architecture Enqueue (insert) : Insert a new element only to the tail of a queue. Dequeue (Delete) : Delete an element only from the head of a queue. Queue ADT * Queue Create (capacity) ::= create an empty queue with the size of capacity return the queue * Queue Enqueue (queue, item) ::= ㆍ if (isFull(queue)) // the queue is full ㆍ else insert an item into the tail of queue return queue ㆍ Element Dequeue (queue) ::= ㆍ if (isEmpty(queue)) // the queue is empty ㆍ else remove the item at the head(front) of the queue and return the item ㆍ Element front (queue) ::= ㆍ if (isEmpty(queue)) // the queue is empty else return the item at the front(head) of the queue ㆍ Element rear (queue) ::= ㆍ if (isEmpty(queue)) // the queue is empty else return the item at the rear(tail) of the queue * Boolean isFull (queue, capacity) ::= return true if the queue is full, else return false * Boolean isEmpty (queue) ::= return true if the queue is empty, else return false - 11 -
